title: SSM organ bucket + state-vs-KV
_evidence: DERIVED from real config.json byte-accounting on read-only ModelLake; O001 row cross-checked against MEASURED O001_NX_state.json (discriminator assert).
_label: SPECIMEN accounting (bf16 activation cache, elem=2), independent of weight quant.

discriminator.claim: the state/KV byte formula reproduces O001's measured numbers

rule.claim: Recurrent-state organs (Mamba/SSM, linear/delta attention) hold a CONSTANT cache independent of context length; full-attention organs hold a KV cache that grows linearly. Resident-memory crossover = state_bytes_constant / kv_bytes_per_token. Below it the SSM state floor dominates; above it KV dominates. The hybrid layer ratio (n_attn : n_ssm), not model size, sets where the crossover falls.

formula.kv_bytes_per_token_per_layer: 2 * n_kv_heads * head_dim * elem  (GQA);  RETUNED per attn flavor (MLA = (kv_lora_rank+qk_rope)*elem)

rule.gravity_decision_changed: SSM/recurrent state is an ACTIVATION cache, not a weight -- the compiler's weight-quant / expert rules do NOT reduce it. It is a FIXED resident floor paid once. For long-context serving the GROWING KV in the attention layers is the Gravity/eviction/quant target, and the hybrid ratio predicts the ctx at which KV overtakes the SSM floor. A pure-SSM body has no KV growth at all (crossover infinite) -> KV-cache levers are inapplicable; the only lever is SSM-state precision. This is the first NON-MoE architecture rule in the compiler.

accounting.notes: Measured in O001_NX_state.json; formula reproduces it exactly.
Same Mamba2 state formula; only the layer partition differs. Sparse attn -> later crossover.
KV term = 0 -> crossover infinite; SSM state is the whole fixed cache floor. Rule holds degenerately.
Dichotomy holds; BOTH size laws change: KDA delta-memory (heads x d^2) for state, MLA latent (kv_lora_rank+rope) for KV.

transfer_summary.does_not_apply: dense and pure-MoE-transformer patients have no recurrent-state organ -> ARCHITECTURE_SPECIFIC
